sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the 
testing procedure P1, which must performed on an annually bases as indicted by 
Y1 in the title block.

The first draft initiated 
by eng. 
Mohamed Abu Elkheir, 
reviewed by eng. Aly Abd Elglil Abd Elqader, 
tested by eng. 
Mohamed Younes Mahmoud at 27 Nov 2004, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. 
Abdel Menem Alemam, accepted by general director eng. Fawzy Sobhy Esmaile, and 
approved by eng. 
Mohamed Hamouda Elsarage 
Head Sector of 
Damietta CCPS.

This control system located at power station main control room, to enable the 
operator to raise and lower the load of the unit and also correcting the some 
factors as level, temperature, pressure ... etc by shift engineer.

The Operator 
Station Consist of:

MSP 
card, processor for CRT#1 , PART # (772B388G57)

MSP 
card, processor for CRT#2 , PART # (772B388G54)

MSP 
بطاقة معالج الطابعة الجزء رقم (772B388G29)

MSP 
card, processor for keyboard , PART # (772B388G55)
MDM card, memory, PART # (7381A81G01).

بطاقة MHC، بطاقة تحكم الطريق السريع للبيانات، الجزء # 
(7381A93G01)

MMI power supply, input 220V AC, output: + 12VDC 
, + 5VDC , PART# (4D33613G02)
Printer , GENICOM 3404 , 3410XCQ color

2CRT , Intecolor , megatrend / 2 , model # 
E01940-20E , part # (406A124H01)

Keyboard , operator keyboard Assy. , part # 
(3D04061G02)

4 cooling fan , 230 VAC , 14 watt , Part # 
(2450D25G03)
احتياطات السلامة
com.endifيجب إصدار تصريح العمل و qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذيرية تحيط بمنطقة العمل.

Wear appropriate 
 personal protective safety equipment as safety shoes
 and helmet
Wear the ground strap.

Disconnect the cabinet from data highway if required according to station 
 status without any effect on operation of plant.

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه
Check the back up software for the cabinet.

Check the operation of net work card function 
 (data highway controller card (MHC card) by using (system highway errors) 
 diagram.
Clean all cabinet cards from dust by blower.

التحقق من حالة الخزانة باستخدام (system 
 عرض الحالة) الرسم البياني.

تحقق من حالة مصدر الطاقة من خلال مصابيح LED الموجودة في المقدمة 
 من إمدادات الطاقة.
Check the performance of operator keyboard.
تحقق من تشغيل مروحة تبريد الخزانة.
Clean the printer.
Clean the two CRT.
Check the configuration program for printer.

Test the 
 operation of printer
